//: Story Phase 11: inspect scripts in the galley and the hold, and the treasure-room door's lock.

then: Your bed: three bean sacks, two crates, a sack of onions, and a folded toy sash where your head goes. It crackles. It smells of cardboard. It's the best thing you own.
else: Your bed: three bean sacks, wedged with two crates and a sack of onions. Over it, his hammock.

then: You lie down. The hammock sways over your face. You get up again.
The Grand Bedside Illumination System: one kerosene lamp, held dead level in the middle of six ropes, while the whole galley tips round it. The flame doesn't even lean.
It works. It is his. You hate it. You read by it.
else: The kerosene lamp, tied to the beams with two ropes. It still swings. You watch it swing.

p11.inspect.peg: The Grand Stenchmaster's ceremonial sash, on its peg for the night. The CLEARANCE tag is still on it. It says FINAL SALE.

then: It hangs very still. You look at it for a long time. You've never liked it so much.
Under SASH HOLDER (RIGHT), newer crayon: GRAND FINGER-PULLER (VACANT, TEMPORARILY).

p11.inspect.porthole: The porthole over the long table, its latch bent, tied shut now with one of Jim's bootlaces.
Out there, somewhere, going round: The Grand Expedition for the Lost Fart. Volume One of Probably Many.
p11.inspect.crate: The Cheap-O-Rama crate. Two hundred and ninety-something boxes left. A sash in every one, two smiling cardboard sash holders, a pull tab, and a pocket edition.
Bob has made a little fort out of the empty boxes. He's in it.
p11.inspect.sash_hammock: A hammock made of Cheap-O-Rama toy sashes, doubled and laced. Red, shiny, crackly. Little embroidered noses all along it.
It won't tear. It's the strongest thing on the ship. It says AGES SIX AND UP on the edge.
p11.treasure_door_sealed: The treasure-room door. Gristle's sign is nailed across it, in big shaky letters: DO NOT OPEN.
Behind it is everything the first release left behind. It's been in there since the beginning. It's not getting out.
